## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is the *Māyopamasamādhisūtra* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on the *rú huàn sānmèi* 如幻三昧 ("illusion-like *samādhi*"), one of the foundational Mahāyāna meditative states focusing on the illusory nature of phenomena.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The Taishō text (T0342) is established on a particularly rich apparatus.
